notes: CDER API-manufacturer CGMP letter (based on a 704(a)(4) records review, not an on-site inspection): failure to validate the manufacturing process and test methods, no stability program, and inadequate water-system qualification for (b)(4) APIs intended for further processing into sterile drug products. The letter never asserts the API itself is sterile, so is_sterile_product is false. All subject APIs are referred to only as '(b)(4) APIs' -- no product name is ever given in clear -- so products is empty and product_redacted is true. No organism is named. Note: the letter states two different FEI digit strings for the same facility -- 'FEI 3035145155' in the opening paragraph identifying the facility and 'FEI 3935145155' in the closing reply instructions -- an apparent digit-transposition typo in the source letter; I used the facility-identifying value as the canonical FEI.
